'''South Dakota Intrastate Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://puc.sd.gov/pipelinesafety/tranmissionoperators.aspx|title=puc.sd.gov|website=puc.sd.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is located in South Dakota.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://puc.sd.gov/pipelinesafety/tranmissionoperators.aspx|title=puc.sd.gov|website=puc.sd.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''South Dakota Intrastate Pipeline Co<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://puc.sd.gov/pipelinesafety/tranmissionoperators.aspx|title=puc.sd.gov|website=puc.sd.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''178 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://puc.sd.gov/pipelinesafety/tranmissionoperators.aspx|title=puc.sd.gov|website=puc.sd.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://puc.sd.gov/pipelinesafety/tranmissionoperators.aspx|title=puc.sd.gov|website=puc.sd.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
